upstox_ws.notes: Phase 1 uses REST Option Greek primarily. Shared upstox_market_feed batches of 100; Tarang may register via set_feed_provider_keys('tarang', keys) capped at max_keys for screener-needed strikes only. Do not change CommDiv behaviour.

ENERGY.rationale: Full CRUDEOIL/NATURALGAS profile-min widths need ~₹18.75k (NG 3-step) to ₹25k (CL 5-step) per lot at zero credit; CL profile-max is ₹40k/lot. Default ₹40k allows ≥1 full lot at profile-min for both and at CL profile-max zero-credit when liquidity allows. Hard cap ₹50k. Portfolio open risk = 2× per-trade = ₹80k. Minis remain disabled (contractFamily=full).

CRYPTO.rationale: Delta BTC/ETH contract_value (0.001 / 0.01) keeps per-contract max loss well under ₹3k–10k at profile widths; keep strategy-doc default until live fills prove otherwise.
